data.summary_en: RSIHub is an open-source framework to build, compare, and extend agent evolution methods via reusable operators/recipes with shared execution/evaluation/lineage; without core changes it instantiates AHE, Hyperagents, A-Evolve, and GEPA, improving overall pass@1 by up to 13.5 percentage points on Terminal Bench 2 and τ^3 Banking.
